what_this_run_decides: This run decides the stand-in protocol only: four cost inputs measured once on one rented single-GPU box, on pairs built from chains of PDB entry 6IHB, not on the card's own pairs and not on the card's 8-GPU setting. It does not run the card's 54-run pilot or its 216-run grid, and it does not evaluate the card's own prediction. Two runs on the same box are two samples of one box, never a replication.
